Overview

Bubbly is a sparkling fruit soda brand built around bold color, playful energy, and the pure joy of flavour. The brief was to create a visual identity that felt as vibrant and refreshing as the product itself — something that could stand out on shelves and connect with a younger, trend-conscious audience.

The gradient can design mirrors the fruit blends inside each flavour — warm reds and yellows for Strawberry Lemon, deep purples for Grape, fresh greens for Lime Elderflower. Every can tells its own colour story while staying unmistakably Bubbly.

The result is a packaging system with personality: bold enough to catch the eye, consistent enough to build a brand.
